name: Mini Remote (RemoteLinc 2)
description: The RemoteLinc 2 Mini Remote, a battery-powered keypad that sleeps between button presses.

operatingFlags.name: programmingLock
operatingFlags.description: Linking and programming from the remote itself are locked out.

operatingFlags.name: stayAwake
operatingFlags.description: The remote stays awake, with 0xFF as its awake interval.

operatingFlags.name: noImAlive
operatingFlags.description: The remote doesn't wake up on its own to send I'm Alive broadcasts.

operatingFlags.name: grouped
operatingFlags.description: Each row's on and off buttons share a group, 1 to 4 from the top. Otherwise each button has its own group, 1 to 8.

readings.name: databaseDelta
readings.description: A count that goes up whenever the ALL-Link database changes. It clears when the device loses power.

values.name: awakeInterval
values.description: How long the remote stays awake, in seconds.

values.name: sleepInterval
values.description: How long the remote sleeps, in steps of 755.2 seconds.

values.name: broadcastCount
values.description: How many times the remote sends its I'm Alive broadcast.

values.name: triggerGroups
values.description: The buttons that are trigger buttons.

values.name: sleepIntervalLow
values.description: The low byte of the sleep interval, in steps of 2.3 seconds.

values.name: appRetries
values.description: How many times the remote retries a message: 0x01 by default, 0x00 for none, or 0xFF to send broadcasts only.

values.name: configuration
values.description: A configuration byte the guide doesn't explain.

writes.name: awakeInterval
writes.description: Sets how long the remote stays awake.

writes.name: sleepInterval
writes.description: Sets how long the remote sleeps.

writes.name: broadcastCount
writes.description: Sets how many times the remote sends its I'm Alive broadcast.

writes.name: triggerGroups
writes.description: Sets the trigger buttons, button 1 in bit 0.

writes.name: appRetries
writes.description: Sets how many times the remote retries a message.

writes.name: lowBatteryLevel
writes.description: Sets the low battery level: 0x00, the default, for none, 0xFF for the device's default level, or another value for a custom level.

extendedCommands.name: readSettings
extendedCommands.description: Reads the remote's intervals, trigger buttons, retries and battery level.

values.name: awakeInterval
values.description: How long the remote stays awake.

values.name: sleepInterval
values.description: How long the remote sleeps, in steps of 755.2 seconds.

values.name: broadcastCount
values.description: How many times the remote sends its I'm Alive broadcast.

values.name: sleepIntervalLow
values.description: The sleep interval's low byte, in steps of 2.3 seconds.

values.name: appRetries
values.description: How many times the remote retries a message.

values.name: configuration
values.description: A configuration byte the guide doesn't explain.

notes: The guide gives the sleep interval's first byte in steps of 755.2 seconds, or 12.5 minutes, and its low byte in steps of 2.3 seconds.
The guide's descriptions of Set Operating Flags 0x08 and 0x09 are unclear for the RemoteLinc 2, so listenOnly has no commands here.
Insteon's file for this guide is named for the 2342, but its title and ID request reply are the RemoteLinc 2's, subcategory 0x10.
